goal: Write and test a complete offline GPU graphics bake with independent local CPU reuse

checks.requirement: Actual graphics generation on authorized personal GPU
checks.evidence: bake_metrics.json: H100, strict checkpoint load, 6400 atlas plus 474 reference frames

checks.requirement: Portable graphical package, states, pose mapping and coverage
checks.evidence: Private package includes manifest, 100 PNG atlases, 100 base frames, small audio ONNX and standalone CPU source; about 107 MB

checks.requirement: Runtime without live neural image generation
checks.evidence: Isolated environment without torch/cv2; runtime.py only image lookup/compositing; audio ONNX explicitly CPUExecutionProvider

checks.requirement: New speech not used to build the atlas
checks.evidence: metrics.json: three held-out Russian phrases; browser additionally used a new custom phrase

checks.requirement: Temporal sequence, moving head and silence
checks.evidence: Receding-horizon state graph, pose-conditioned atlas, ping-pong body path, explicit neutral override; 9 unit tests
browser_metrics.json: stop active and preparing audio, no stale restart, next phrase works, idle body continues

checks.requirement: Measured quality loss, speed, memory, disk
checks.evidence: metrics.json, isolated_cpu.metrics.json, browser_metrics.json; isolated peak RSS 183156736 bytes

checks.requirement: Runnable manual test, tests and reproduction
checks.evidence: lab.py on loopback 8897; README.md, REPRODUCE.md, portable CLI package

not_claimed: Human-level realism or absence of uncanny valley
Proven correct Russian phoneme articulation by the upstream audio driver
Unrestricted arbitrary poses, emotion or infinite unique body motion
Streaming TTS integration with the production Pipecat trainer
Commercial clearance for the demonstration identity or model weights
